nom: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Essence Water Hydrating Face Toner for Dry

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it doesn't leave a greasy feeling and works well as a lightweight hydrating base.
segments.dry: This product is marketed for dry skin, and most reviewers with dry, sensitive or flaky-prone skin report it hydrates, soothes and softens; however, one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin found the opposite — her skin felt drier after two weeks of use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily/acne-prone and dry-with-oily-patches variations, report it improved their skin's overall health and glow without feeling heavy in the oilier areas.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report it is soothing and gentle, but a minority report serious reactions — one describes an allergic, burning reaction to the niacinamide within seconds of use, another had her skin flare up with redness and rash after a year of trouble-free use, and one had mild burning on first use.
segments.mature: The two reviewers in their 50s who mention their age report their skin looks fabulous and healthy with consistent use, and no longer dull.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who bought this specifically for anti-aging, since ginseng is known for that property, says she hasn't yet seen anti-aging benefits, though she notes she doesn't have fine lines yet to judge by.
concerns.dehydration: This is the essence's core reported strength: the great majority of reviewers, including several with dry or flaky skin, describe fast, lasting hydration and a soft, plump, glowing finish; one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin is a clear exception, reporting her skin felt drier after use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report the essence calms redness, including rosacea-related redness and post-acne marks, over consistent use; however, a few report the opposite — a burning, inflamed reaction on first use, and one describes a redness and rash flare-up after a year of otherwise trouble-free use.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers credit consistent use with a noticeably stronger, better-maintained skin barrier and less dryness overall.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who addresses pigmentation reports it helped fade dark post-acne marks along with reducing redness.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report it calms acne and helps breakouts heal, including one using it preventively and another whose daughter uses it to calm acne after facial treatments.

aspects.libelle: Watery, lightweight texture that layers without stickiness
Little to no noticeable fragrance beyond a faint ginseng scent
Good value, a little goes a long way
Occasional quality-control issues on arrival (unsealed, underfilled, or seemingly older stock)
Applied by hand rather than as a mist, which some find impractical

extraits.texte: I dont usually write product reviews but hopefully someone takes this into account when looking to purchase - this product contains NIACINAMIDE which can cause allergic reactions like it did for me. Obviously I wouldnt have purchased if i knew this was a possible side effect, but even just about 30 seconds after use my skin became inflamed and I started to feel a burning sensation. The more white parts you can see in the photos are my natural skin tone and this is 2 minutes after applying as directed. PLEASE DONT USE IF YOU HAVE A KNOWN HISTORY OF NIACIN REACTIONS !! Disappointed because I love trying new skin products but im not sure why a company would use an ingredient that has inflaming properties on a facial skincare product. Niacin flush is a well documented side affect for a large portion of the population, so please be aware of the affect this could have on your skin.

I have really sensitive and dry skin. Thought this product would help from what I’ve read in the description . Used a few drops every morning in my routine for about 2 weeks now, my skin did not agree with it and feels so dry, which I worked so hard to make smooth . The bottle itself looks great. I’m sure it works, just not for me:(

extraits.titre: It was great till it was not..
extraits.texte: I really do not do reviews but in this case I feel like I have to, to warn people have sensitive skin to be careful if they want to try this skincare line. I ordered my first beauty of Joseon last year I got the ginseng toner, the cleanser and the serum that goes with it. Up on using the product I felt that my skin is healthy and glowing and clear then it have ever been. And to make it clear I have a hyper sensitive skin and on top of that I have eczema so my skin can flare up anytime if it wants to or if I use something that irritates it. Since I use the products for a year everything was doing fine everything was perfect I'm loving the product there's no problem with it my skin is loving it not until the beginning of this year all of a sudden my face broke out. My face started to itch I thought it was just itchy but when I look at it on the mirror I see some redness on my skin and some rash, so basically my face was flaring up but I did not blame it to the skincare that I was using because like I said a year prior everything was perfect so I thought it's just my skin doing its thing and it's going to go away. So I stopped using the skin care line until my face was fully healed so that was about June when my face finally healed from the flare-up that I had from the beginning of the this year. I didn't use the toner because I ran out, but I still have the oil based cleanser and I'm being using it on and off and my face is okay it didn't flare up it no allergic reaction or any

I have oily combo skin that's acne prone but I got this as preventative skincare since ginseng is known to be anti-aging and I'm in my 20s. Right of the bat, I love how the packaging feels, it's very nice quality since it's sleek and has a weight to it. The product itself has no fragrance at all which will work well for people who are sensitive to fragrances. The consistency is slightly thicker than water but it's still very runny! This absorbs so well into the skin and doesn't feel tacky at all, I find that this is very moisturizing on my skin. After the first few uses, I can definitely see an overall improvement in my skin health and it gave my skin a nice glow. After using it for a while, my skin barrier has been a lot better! I don't see any anti-aging benefits yet, but that's also because I don't have fine-lines yet. But overall, this product is great for the skin barrier and glow! Your face will feel very soft

[Beauty of Joseon] Ginseng Essence Water. Nourishing essence that instantly hydrates, soothes and softens my dry, Sensitive and flaky prone skin. The essence has a thickened liquid feel. It absorbs and works quickly. Feels lightweight. Works well under my cream and makeup. Good first moisturizing layer. My makeup applies smoother and more evenly. Has a light ginseng scent that dissipates quickly. Per the description, the formula contains 80% Ginsengroot water and niacinamide 2% and is free of artificial fragrance, colorants, essential oil, and mineral oil. Made in Korea. Expiration date 20241107. Good for dry Sensitive skin!
My skin LOVES this stuff. It helped with me darker areas from post acne hyperpigmentation and redness so much!
